entities.summary: Frederick Allen Boyd Jr. is an American farmer, lobbyist and politician and the former United States Representative for Florida's 2nd congressional district from 1997 to 2011. He is a member of the Democratic Party. He currently works for a lobbying firm, the Twenty-First Century Group.
